name: Acro
description: Shoe for technical sport climbing and bouldering, offered in low- and regular-volume fits with a leather upper and tensioned half-length midsole.

officialSpecs.midsole: Tensioned rubber and half-length 3D injection-molded Pebax

name: Acro Comp
description: Soft, downturned shoe for steep sport climbing, bouldering and gym climbing, with a large thin toe patch, molded heel cup and 4 mm outsole.

name: Endeavor
description: Slightly asymmetric all-around shoe with a near-neutral last, microsuede upper and an ABS midsole extended toward the toe for edging support.

officialSpecs.midsole: ABS midsole extended toward the front

name: Gomi
description: Downturned sport and bouldering shoe with a 4 mm outsole, large thin toe patch, high-tension heel rand and 3D-molded heel cup.
